basic_info.description: Constructed in 1908, this property comprises 10 residential units and 3 commercial spaces, presenting a unique  blend of residential and commercial income streams. The residential units are currently 100% occupied,  providing immediate and consistent cash flow. The commercial spaces feature the established Church Street  Cafe (month-to-month lease), Positive Green LLC (new five-year lease), and a vacant space formerly occupied by  a plumbing company, offered vacant for immediate tenant placement or owner use.  This property presents a rare opportunity to acquire a well-maintained, income-producing asset in one of San  Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. The combination of stable current income, high rental upside, and a  prime location makes this an exceptional investment.
